---
title: "DNAnexus in 5 minutes"
---

## Your training project

The training project contains shared materials and a workspace assigned to you. You will normally see folders similar to:

```text
01_DATA/
02_MATERIALS/
03_TEMPLATES/
participant-XX/
```

Use your assigned `participant-XX` folder for your own work.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Do not modify shared materials

Treat `01_DATA`, `02_MATERIALS` and `03_TEMPLATES` as instructor-managed resources. Create and modify your own files in your participant folder.
:::

## Project storage and `/mnt/project`

Within JupyterLab, files stored in the current DNAnexus project can be accessed from R under `/mnt/project`.

For example:

```r
dat <- read.csv("/mnt/project/01_DATA/example_data.csv")
head(dat)
```

You do not need to download the project data to your computer to analyse it in R.
